The project is not a git repository. Let me provide a summary of the changes made.

## Summary

Successfully integrated the Thai conversational chat journey into the OOTDay Fashion Assistant UI:

### Changes Made:
- **`frontend/components/chat/ChatAssistant.tsx`**:
  - Added `useEffect` import
  - Added initial Thai greeting message: "อ้ายฮายย👋 กำลังหาชุดไปไหนอยู่น้าา" when chat loads
  - Updated fallback empty state text to Thai: "สวัสดีค่ะ! OOTDay Stylist พร้อมช่วยหาลุคที่ใช่สำหรับคุณค่ะ ✨"

- **`frontend/components/chat/OutfitRecommendationCard.tsx`**:
  - Changed "View" button text to "ดูลุค"
  - Changed items count from "X items" to "X ชิ้น"
  - Removed unused `ShoppingBag` import

- **`frontend/components/chat/QuickPrompts.tsx`**:
  - Updated all quick prompts to Thai:
    - "ชุดไปทำงาน" → "อยากได้ชุดไปทำงาน"
    - "ชุดไปงานแต่ง" → "หาชุดไปงานแต่งงาน"
    - "ชุดใส่เที่ยว" → "อยากได้ชุดใส่ไปเที่ยว"
    - "ชุดวันหยุด" → "ชุดคาสชวล วันหยุด สบายๆ"

### Validated:
- System prompt (`system-prompt-v2.ts`) already contains all required Thai conversational elements including social proof phrases ("กำลังมาแรง", "stock sold out", "สาวๆ หากันให้ควัก")
- `Outfit` type already has `title` field for Look titles
- Compilation successful (✓)
- All grep validations passed

### Files Changed:
| File | Changes |
|------|---------|
| `frontend/components/chat/ChatAssistant.tsx` | +13 lines, ~2 modified |
| `frontend/components/chat/OutfitRecommendationCard.tsx` | ~3 lines modified |
| `frontend/components/chat/QuickPrompts.tsx` | ~4 lines modified |

**Note:** The project is not a git repository, so `git diff --stat` cannot be run. Pre-existing lint errors and build error (missing encoder.json file) are unrelated to these changes.
